Case studies

From business problem to working system

Each case study follows the same path: the challenge, what I built, the impact, the proof, and how it applies to your business.

Generative AI · MindForge Coach AI Knowledge Assistant
Business challenge

Valuable knowledge sits in manuals, policies, training files and product documents. Employees and customers spend time searching for answers, and often get inconsistent ones.

Solution delivered

A knowledge-grounded AI assistant that retrieves answers from a defined source of truth and cites the exact page. If the answer isn’t in the material, it says so instead of inventing one. It runs as an agent with conversation memory and a streaming API, and a second version runs on Microsoft Azure AI Foundry.

Business impact
  • Less time spent searching through documents
  • Faster access to internal knowledge for employees
  • More consistent answers for customers
  • Every answer traceable to its source
  • Works in Arabic and English
Proof

Grounded in a 201-page book with page-level citations. The full code is open on GitHub.

Machine learning · Clinical decision-support model Predictive Risk & Decision Intelligence
Business challenge

Historical data can predict future outcomes, but decision-makers won’t act on a prediction they can’t understand.

Solution delivered

A machine-learning model that predicts one-year patient survival and explains every prediction, showing which factors pushed the result up or down. Its probabilities are calibrated, so a predicted 70% means 70%, and drift monitoring flags when the model needs retraining after launch.

Business impact
  • Decisions backed by evidence, not intuition
  • Transparent reasoning your team can review
  • Reliable performance after deployment
Proof

AUC-ROC of 0.88 on held-out data, with a live demo and open code.

Live demoGitHub
How it applies to your business

Customer churn prediction, fraud and anomaly detection, credit and risk scoring, demand forecasting, conversion prediction and operational forecasting.

About

A physicist who builds AI that businesses can use

I’m Khalida Khaldi — a data scientist and AI engineer with a PhD in mathematical physics, carried out in collaboration with Ohio University (USA) and Ruhr University Bochum (Germany), a master’s in data science from the University of Colorado Boulder, and the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate. I spent years turning hard problems into working systems in research and industry; now I do it for businesses, independently, through my practice MindForge. What sets my work apart in this region: I build genuinely technical AI — the kind still rare in the Gulf market — and I do it fluently in Arabic as well as English. You get the engineering, and a partner who explains it in terms your business can use.
